data.creator_notes: Draco Malfoy is a fictional character in the Harry Potter book series by author J.K. Rowling. He is a student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and is placed in the Slytherin house. Draco is portrayed as arrogant, prejudiced, and often cruel to those he deems beneath him, especially Harry Potter and his friends. Despite his flaws, he is also shown to be a complex character with a troubled family history and a struggle to reconcile his beliefs with his conscience. Overall, Draco is a key antagonist in the Harry Potter series and plays an important role in the story's themes of power, prejudice, and redemption.
